changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Adds a metadata JSONB column to actions for optional per-action guidance_link and available_area_type (total, partial, limited) fields. available_area_type governs how the user must enter a value relative to availableArea: 'total' requires the full amount, 'partial' allows any amount up to and including the total, 'limited' allows an amount capped below the total.
